title: Kiln profile (<game>/kiln/profile.json), format 1
description: Written atomically by the Kiln Launcher when it activates a profile; read once by kiln-core at boot (service kiln.profile) and by Kiln.Host, the native loader and kiln-emf. Missing file: the legacy layout (kiln/mods). Unreadable or invalid file: no mods, an error in kiln.log and state/boot.json. Paths are game-side (contracts.md, path translation). Unknown keys are ignored. The core refuses profiles over 16 MiB or with JSON nesting deeper than 128 levels.

generation.description: Bumped by every write; kiln-core echoes it in state/boot.json.

pathMode.description: z: Z:\ paths into the launcher library (Proton); native: Windows paths; copy: mods copied under <game>/kiln/profiles/<id>/, relative paths.

dataDir.description: Per-mod data root (kiln/data/<id> by default). World data (kiln/data/worlds) never moves.

dropins.description: Also load the drop-in folders (kiln/mods, kiln/native, kiln/plugins, emf/mods, and each engine plugin's own folder) after the listed mods: true = every kind, or a list of kinds.

eml.description: EML mods (mod.json + src/mod.lua), read by kiln-eml from the profile's text.

shroudforge.description: ShroudForge packages. The launcher places each in ShroudForge's mods folder and sets its extended.mod.json switch; kiln-shroudforge hosts ShroudForge when an entry is enabled. path: the placed folder.

set.description: Shrouded Engine Tweaks mods. The launcher places the enabled ones in shrouded_engine_tweaks/mods/<id>/, where kiln-set reads them. path: the placed folder.

greeneye.description: Greeneye Loader mods (mod.json + DLL), read by kiln-greeneye.

shroudtopia.description: Shroudtopia mods (a folder with the mod DLL), read by kiln-shroudtopia.

enshwick.description: Enshwick mods (a DLL exporting enshwick_mod_*, or a pack.toml data pack / Luau mod). kiln-enshwick copies each enabled entry into <game>/mods/<id>/ (the only folder Enshwick's loader reads) and starts Enshwick's own loader. path: the library folder.

shroudlink.description: shroudlink server mod DLLs, read by kiln-shroudlink (shroudlink's own server core). path: the library folder of mod DLLs, or one mod DLL.

ember.description: Ember server SDK mods (a folder with one library), found and reported by kiln-ember. They don't run yet: Ember has published no mod ABI. path: the mod folder or its library.

mods.description: One list per mod kind. kiln-core counts kiln, native, plugin and emf (kiln.profile count/get); each engine plugin reads its own list from the profile's text (kiln.profile json()). Kilns older than these lists warn about and ignore an engine list; they never make the profile invalid.
